item.title: Miss MHS 2026
item.description: Cassandra Hill (c) was crowned Miss MHS 2026 at the annual Miss MHS Pageant held on Wednesday, Feb. 18. She also received the “Miss Photogenic” award. Members of her court include Charissa Hall (r), 1st runner-up and winner of the Congeniality and People’s Choice award, along with Elle Carter (l), 2nd runner-up. photo courtesy of BPI Photography The post Miss MHS 2026 first appeared on Metter Advertiser.
